personal.heroDescription: Pushing the boundaries of intelligent systems that can reason, plan, and interact with the world.

paragraphs.text: I am a Research Scientist at Huawei 2012 Labs, dedicated to advancing the frontiers of artificial intelligence.

I received my Ph.D. from the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2015. Before joining Huawei, I worked as an assistant professor at the University of Jinan in Shandong province for over two years.

My research focuses on building intelligent systems that can understand, reason, and interact with the world. I collaborate with talented researchers worldwide to push the boundaries of AI technology, with publications in top venues including ICLR, ICML, CVPR, NeurIPS, IJCAI, and AAAI.

research.title: Foundation Models
research.description: Research on large-scale pre-trained models including LLMs and Multimodal models, focusing on data synthesis, post-training methodologies, and emergent capabilities.

research.title: Reinforcement Learning
research.description: Developing RL algorithms for sequential decision-making, including policy optimization, reward modeling, and alignment techniques like RLHF.

research.title: AI Agents
research.description: Building autonomous agents powered by LLMs/LMMs that can reason, plan, use tools, and execute complex tasks in real-world environments.

research.title: Embodied AI
research.description: Creating intelligent systems that can perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world through robotic manipulation and sensorimotor learning.
